note: Actual outbound customs shipments are confirmed, not merely claimed: two dated Chennai Air export records (Vietnam 2025-11-12, Kenya 2025-11-10) with HS 90189032 and BOL numbers 1941690 and 3755684, plus a recurring buyer network in the US, Germany, Singapore and Ireland. Declared HS 901890 is consistent with the observed export HS 90189032 (medical/surgical instruments — blood/cell collection bags), so no HS correction is needed; note the claimed industry "IT и электроника" is wrong — the company is a medical-device / life-sciences supplier. The company is also a substantial importer (tube sealers, grinding wheels, films, freezing bags), i.e. it operates as a manufacturer-trader of cell-therapy consumables. Domestic Indian supply evidence was NOT found in accessible sources — this is a data-access gap (all Indian registries and financial aggregators blocked), not proof of absence, hence domestic_status = unknown rather than none_found. Revenue and export volume figures: null — not public on the free views; do not infer from the 344-record count. No sanctions/court/ownership issues were examined (out of scope for this role).
